title: 重新审视一下当前agentloop 的任务的生命周期管理，考虑多多任务并发的情况，实现更好的单任务配置和单任务管理，也允许用户进行批量配置和批量管理

goal.raw_request: 重新审视一下当前agentloop 的任务的生命周期管理，考虑多多任务并发的情况，实现更好的单任务配置和单任务管理，也允许用户进行批量配置和批量管理

acceptance_criteria.description: Per-task state is the source of truth: .agentloop/tasks/<task_id>/state.json is read/written directly by all lifecycle operations; the global .agentloop/state.json no longer gates whether a new task can be started.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: agentloop/tasks.py:save_task_state mirrors to legacy only when current; workflow.start_task/approve_task/cancel_task/run_one_iteration use load_task_state + save_task_state for per-task IO.

acceptance_criteria.description: agentloop start can be invoked while another task is in any non-terminal state (e.g. WAITING_FOR_ALIGNMENT or DESIGNING); the new task is created without error and both tasks appear in agentloop tasks list with their independent statuses.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_multitask.py::test_start_allows_multiple_concurrent_tasks; start_task no longer gates on legacy state.status.

acceptance_criteria.description: Lifecycle commands accept a --task-id <id> (or positional <id>) selector for agentloop approve, cancel, run, status, and act on that task only, regardless of which task is current.

When exactly one task is active, lifecycle commands without --task-id keep working against that task (backwards compatibility); when zero or multiple are active, the CLI errors with a message that lists candidate task_ids.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tasks.resolve_task_id branches on active count; tests test_ambiguous_bare_command_lists_candidates and test_bare_command_works_with_single_active.

acceptance_criteria.description: Two agentloop run invocations against different task_ids can execute without corrupting each other's state.json, artifacts, or runs/ logs. Test command output is namespaced under .agentloop/runs/<task_id>/<iteration>/.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: runner.run_test_commands(task_id=...) and adapters.run_role(task_id=...) namespace under runs/<task_id>/<iteration>/; test_run_namespaces_logs_per_task asserts per-task run dirs.

acceptance_criteria.description: A per-task lock prevents two concurrent run invocations on the same task_id from interleaving; the second invocation either waits or fails fast with a clear 'task is locked by pid X' error.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: agentloop/locks.py uses os.O_CREAT|O_EXCL with PID/host payload, stale reclaim via _pid_alive; cli.cmd_run wraps in task_lock(blocking=wait) and exits 2 with LockHeld; test_run_fails_fast_when_task_locked verifies.

acceptance_criteria.description: Per-task config overrides exist: .agentloop/tasks/<task_id>/config.json may override test_commands, max_iterations, and role->runtime assignments. Merge order is documented: per-task override > global config > built-in default.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tasks.effective_config deep-merges per-task override over global config; ALLOWED_TOP_KEYS = {test_commands, max_iterations, roles, default_runtime}; documented in docs/agentloop-design.md §23.4.

acceptance_criteria.description: A CLI surface for single-task configuration exists (e.g. agentloop tasks config set/show <task_id>), and changes are reflected on the next agentloop run <task_id>.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cli tasks config show/set/unset/clear subcommands; tests test_per_task_test_commands_override_takes_effect and test_config_show_returns_override_and_effective.

acceptance_criteria.description: Batch lifecycle commands exist for at least approve, cancel, run. They accept explicit ids (--task-id repeatable), --all, or --status filtering. Per-task failures are reported individually and do not abort the remaining batch.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cmd_tasks_batch_approve/cancel/run + _run_batch_op return per-task (status,tid,message) and _print_batch_summary returns 1 if any failed; test_batch_cancel_isolates_failures verifies.

acceptance_criteria.description: Batch configuration commands exist: a single tasks config set invocation can target multiple task_ids (--task-id repeated, --all, or --status) and apply the same override to each.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cmd_tasks_config_set uses _resolve_selection (--task-id/--all/--status); test_batch_config_set_all asserts override is written to every task.

acceptance_criteria.description: Documentation (docs/agentloop-design.md or a new doc) is updated to describe the new multi-task lifecycle, per-task config precedence, batch operations, and concurrency/locking model.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: docs/agentloop-design.md §23 (lines 857-964) documents storage, source-of-truth, concurrency/locking, per-task config precedence, and full CLI surface.

acceptance_criteria.description: Existing single-task workspaces continue to work after upgrade: either via automatic migration on first command, or via a documented agentloop tasks migrate command. No data loss for the existing task.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tasks.migrate_workspace is idempotent, copies legacy state into per-task file, relocates legacy numeric runs/ dirs under current task; lazily invoked in cli.main; test_migration_copies_legacy_state_into_per_task_file verifies.

acceptance_criteria.description: Requester reviews and approves the task-specific analysis and acceptance criteria before execution starts.
